name: Cardano Studio
description_short: Self-custody NFT minting in your browser.
description_long: Mint NFTs on Cardano fully in your browser — no signup, no third party in the minting flow, you sign and submit transactions yourself. Supports CIP-25 metadata, CIP-27 royalties, and CIP-60 music NFTs, with CSV collection import and transaction bundling (30+ NFTs per transaction at a flat 2 ADA fee). Developed in Switzerland.
